blurb: This check verifies that the ndpd-host (IPv6 Neighbor Discovery host) daemon is not started at boot on a system that does not use IPv6. The rule is Not Applicable when ifconfig shows IPv6 (inet6) configured. When IPv6 is not in use, an uncommented "start /usr/sbin/ndpd-host" line in /etc/rc.tcpip is a finding: it boots an unneeded network-facing daemon that an auditor will flag on a non-IPv6 server.
